preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 50.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= goals <= 100 for goals in home_goals + away_goals)
preconditions.description: The number of goals scored by each team in each match is between 0 and 100.
The length of the name of each team does not exceed 10.
The name of each team contains only lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T lines, one for each test case.
Each line contains exactly two space-separated strings, representing the top-ranked and second top-ranked teams.

postconditions.expression: all(leader_pair.split()[0] != leader_pair.split()[1] for leader_pair in result)
postconditions.description: The top-ranked and second top-ranked teams are different for each test case.
